{{Quote|Come to the Imperial Palace Casino Hotel where your credits go farther! The best casino on Worlport, open nightly and serving the best drinks at the lowest prices! Come try your luck at the Imperial Palace Casino Hotel!|Imperial Palace Casino advertisement|<ref name="SWG:KBW" />}}
The '''Imperial Palace Casino Hotel''' was a hotel and casino that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent [[Rya Skodhan]] worked as a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] dealer at the Imperial Palace and spied on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers who visited it. She also broke into their rooms, to search for anything that could be of value to the Alliance.
